arguments.label: iOS dropped fixes: scroll + captions (rows 6-8)
arguments.task:
Goal: file up to THREE upstream PRs (openclaw/openclaw, fork Marvinthebored), one per fix, and drive each to CI green and rating platinum hermit (4/6) or better. Peter wants them filed as soon as possible, does not want to wait for anything, and wants you to decide yourself. Stop only for something you truly cannot fix.

The fixes (rows 6, 7, 8 of projects/openclaw-ios/DROPPED-FIXES-PLAN.md; details, evidence and patches in projects/openclaw-ios/DROPPED-FIXES.md, tickets T388.77.1, .4, .10): (6) chat jumps when the server trims old messages; (7) a small scroll-up away from the bottom is overridden when a reply ends; (8) working/completed captions lose the shared compact claw layout. Patch files: projects/openclaw-ios/tmp/dropped-fixes-20261106/ (history-window-retention.patch, live-edge-threshold.patch, working-line-layout.patch). They were written in October against a private base that no longer exists, so port them. Read projects/openclaw-ios/BLANK-CHAT.md first: PR #163153 (open, rated gold) and the blank-chat work touch the same scroll code, and the current Astra scroll stack in build 102493 may already change fixes 6 and 7. Check before porting each fix whether current origin/main (fetch it) or an open PR already covers it; if so, say so with code evidence and don't file a duplicate. Peter's scroll rules (BLANK-CHAT.md "Symptom and Peter's rules"): scrolled up, nothing moves; folds never move the visible text.

Rules:
- The fixes were already proven in October (phone-tested and simulator-tested before the rebase). Proof burden now: port onto fresh origin/main in an isolated worktree under ~/.openclaw/tmp/ (first run `readlink /opt/homebrew/lib/node_modules/openclaw`; never build in that tree), keep each diff minimal, add or port a test that fails on main and passes with the fix when feasible. One red/green simulator job per fix through bin/pmac-phone job templates (projects/openclaw-ios/BUILD-ENV.md; no hand-written job scripts, nothing in /tmp) is enough. The pmac lock is shared and queues for hours: set LOCK_WAIT long and arm a PMAC_WAKE_SESSION wake plus a backup `at` automation. The earlier hold on simulator jobs is LIFTED (Peter, 7 Nov).
- Reviews: use `opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3-contributor` subagents for the same-family and cross-family reviews the upstream PR skill (~/.claude/skills/openclaw-upstream-pr/SKILL.md) asks for. No Anthropic models, no Opus. (If that model errors, fall back to xai/grok-4.7 and say so.)
- Porting existing fixes as specified is fine; do not change layout or look beyond what the originals did.
- Check open-PR count below 20 before each filing (`gh pr list -R openclaw/openclaw --author Marvinthebored --state open --json number -q length`; 13 now, budget 7 for all dropped fixes).
- Order: 7 and 6 first (scroll), then 8. Tell charlie via `SWARM_AGENT=marvin ~/bin/swarm-send charlie ...` that you own rows 6-8 now, and reuse any of its worktree work (see the tail of `tmux capture-pane -p -t charlie`, ~/.openclaw/tmp).
- After each filing: stay on it until CI green and rating platinum+ (read the ClawSweeper review, fix findings that are ours; use projects/openclaw-ios/bin/pr-rating-wait and pr-rereview-wait, no polling loops).
- Record progress in DROPPED-FIXES-PLAN.md (PR column), `cd ~/.openclaw && ~/bin/task add 388.77.N pr "..." --ref openclaw/openclaw#NNN --as marvin`, then projects/openclaw-ios/bin/ios-register. Report each PR link to the parent when filed and at platinum.

# Talk consult thinking compatibility

6 Nov 2026: Peter authorized fix and upstream filing; no deploy/restart or config changes.

Worktree: `/Users/admin/.openclaw/tmp/talk-consult-thinking`, branch `fix/talk-consult-thinking`, fresh origin/main `2a2cd2931454fe75687b2dec1104289b9a66c273`.

Trace: chat-backed Talk passes consultThinkingLevel to chat.send thinking. Reply admission treats it as an explicit choice and rejects unsupported levels after resolving agent/session model. Native embedded command attempts already resolve thinking per candidate (`src/agents/command/run-embedded-attempt.ts`). Candidate patch marks only internal Talk consult dispatch as a machine-selected override and normalizes at reply admission using existing thinkingSelection.level. Human explicit choices retain rejection.

### Summary

Chat-backed Talk consults can reject a configured thinking level that the consult target model does not support, instead of using that model's supported equivalent.

### Reproduction

1. Configure Talk with `consultThinkingLevel: off`.
2. Use a consult target model whose advertised thinking levels exclude `off` (for example, a Claude Opus route advertising low/medium/high).
3. Ask Talk a question requiring an agent consult.

The internal consult forwards the preference as an explicit `chat.send` thinking override. Reply admission returns `Thinking level "off" is not supported ...` before the agent executes.

### Expected behavior

Resolve the machine-selected Talk preference against the actual consult execution model. Preserve supported preferences and ordinary explicit user-command validation. Do not persist a normalized value to the session, or discard the original preference needed by fallback candidates.

### Evidence

A focused reply-admission regression on current main fails for Talk `off` before agent execution. With the fix, all six focused admission cases pass, including supported low/high, retained original override, inherited thinking, and ordinary explicit rejection. Four request-normalization cases verify
